close_reason: Already defended: session_parts is pub(crate) with explicit signature returning (&str, &str). The shape is correct as filed; this is a Section-6 'good-decision' note, no code change required.
description:
src/methods/mod.rs:242-253: `session_parts(&self) -> Result<(&str, &str), ClientError>` returns two borrows of self.session. Every method call immediately uses both in the same expression and discards. This is fine; it allocates nothing.

Note: had this been written as `(String, String)`, every method call would allocate two Strings per request — a small but non-zero hot-path cost given that calendar_get etc. are likely called frequently. The current shape is the right choice. Filing only as a Section 6 'what is good' decision so a future contributor doesn't 'simplify' it to owned strings.
title: session_parts() returns &str when callers immediately serialize as &str — correct, but borrow ties &self
